title: Stochastic Galerkin and Monte-Carlo methods for parabolic problems: Numerical performance of variational matrix-free approximations
summary: Stochastic Galerkin methods offer unexplored potential for the numerical simulation of parabolic problems with random variables, in particular if they are combined with variational discretizations of the space and time variables. Due to the high dimensionality, the solution of the arising algebraic systems do not become feasible without efficient solvers, preconditioners, and software architectures.
